h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Aurangabad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Aurangabad

items.pText: Aurangabad, now officially Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, has a large industrial base, and its companies sometimes fund playgrounds for village schools, anganwadis and municipal gardens as part of their CSR work. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment for these projects and for the city's schools, housing societies and hotels. Our factory in Vasai is about 260 km away, and we send each order by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

A CSR playground has two clients, the company paying for it and the school or community that will look after it. Both need to agree on the layout, the age groups and who will maintain it after handover. We find it helps to choose low-maintenance pieces with galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts. A clear warranty in writing is useful for the company's records too. The Marathwada climate is semi-arid, with hot summers and a modest monsoon, and the hard ground here usually suits grouted posts.

richText.heading: Planning a playground as a CSR project

items: Visit the school or anganwadi with its head and agree the space and age groups.
Share photos with us. We send a layout drawing and quote the company can approve.
Agree in writing who will sweep, check bolts and call our after-sales team if something needs attention.
Plan the handover so the school knows the maintenance steps.

items.q: Can you supply a playground for a company's CSR project?
items.a: Yes. We work with the company and the school or community together, send a layout drawing and quote for approval, and install the equipment through our own team or a dealer.

items.q: What equipment suits a village school or anganwadi?
items.a: Sturdy, low-maintenance pieces such as spring riders, see-saws, swings and a small multi play system. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts need little upkeep beyond sweeping and checking bolts.

items.q: Who maintains the playground after a CSR handover?
items.a: Usually the school or community. We share maintenance steps at handover, and our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 can help with spares.
